description: Develop and maintain React and Next.js applications for internal tools and client-facing banking platforms, with a focus on performance, accessibility, and maintainable component architecture.
Build backend services and REST APIs with Nest.js that support core banking operations, ensuring security, reliability, and clear service contracts.
Design, implement, and maintain production conversational bot flows in Genesys Cloud Architect, integrating them with internal services to automate customer interactions and reduce agent workload.
Designed and built frontend applications for logistics management, turning complex operational processes into clear, efficient user workflows.
Integrated web applications with Nest.js REST APIs, collaborating with backend engineers to define data contracts and keep services consistent.
Identified bottlenecks in day-to-day operations and shipped iterative improvements based on user feedback, increasing team efficiency.
Applied solid architecture and code quality practices to keep the codebase scalable and easy to evolve within an agile, cross-functional team.
Led the technical direction of the company's sites and internal platforms, owning frontend architecture and its integration with Nest.js backend services.
Built the company's cross-platform mobile app in Flutter end to end, from development to release and ongoing management on the App Store and Google Play.
Defined the technology stack, project structure, and development tooling, establishing standards adopted across the team.
Mentored developers and drove code reviews, promoting best practices in performance, scalability, and data handling.
Partnered with stakeholders to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliverable features.
Built responsive and accessible user interfaces with modern frontend frameworks for clients across multiple industries.
Integrated third-party services and APIs into customer-facing applications.
Worked in agile teams alongside designers, backend developers, and product owners to deliver projects on schedule.
Contributed to shared components and internal tools that accelerated delivery across projects.
